india_trends.title: Escorts Kubota Q1 FY27 results: Net profit rises 4.4% to Rs 386 crore, revenue jumps 28%

The company enjoyed a significant 28 percent increase in operational revenue, amounting to Rs 3,207.55 crore. Revenue from agri machinery rose by 27 percent while construction equipment sales jumped 39 percent.
